_doc: Canonical FREE swap order for think (and Hub free routing). Outer think tick rotates hermes -m through this list on 429/empty. Hermes same-provider fallback_providers does NOT swap model ids (retries -m 3×) — this file is the real failover SoT. Cap ~8–12. Re-probe with .staging/model-probe/probe_free_models.py before editing. Never add paid. Skip sunset/dead in _do_not_readd.

policy.inbox_when: entire ordered list 429/fail for the UTC day AND paid last-resort disabled/failed (not primary-only)
policy.skip_hermes_when: never by default — after full free exhaust, think uses THINK_PAID_MODEL (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash) until free reset; set THINK_PAID_ON_FREE_EXHAUSTED=0 (alias THINK_ALLOW_PAID_LAST_RESORT=0) to restore skip
policy.paid_scenarios: C8 only: (1) free pool exhausted THINK_PAID_ON_FREE_EXHAUSTED; (2) verified free failure THINK_PAID_ON_VERIFIED_FREE_FAIL after THINK_PAID_FREE_FAIL_N harness verify-fails (default 2). See agents/THINK_SECURITY_CHECKS.md C8.
policy.paid_last_resort: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash (ops OpenRouter key; scenario 1 after free rotate/fast-probe exhaust, or scenario 2 one paid after N verified free fails)
policy.shared_daily_cap_note: OpenRouter free-models-per-day-high-balance is often one shared pool across :free ids (Limit 1000 RPD) — still rotate/probe the full list before scenario-1 paid.
policy.mid_day_reprobe: when models_429 covers full ordered list, think-tick re-probes before paid (false exhaust / mid-day recovery)
policy.availability_check: daily hermes-model-health (06:45) + weekly probe-free-models-weekly.sh (Sun) → reports/model-probe/ + last_probe here
